title: Awarepreneurs #396 — 'From Lean Startup to Incorruptible Social Enterprises'
summary: Paul Zelizer's Awarepreneurs — the podcast for conscious entrepreneurs and social-impact founders — ends a six-week creative pause with a launch-day Eric Ries episode for #396, framed around two decades of continuous innovation, long-term thinking, governance, and market reform.
blockquote: Over the last two decades, Eric Ries's ideas about continuous innovation, long-term thinking, governance, and market reform have reshaped company building and management practices.
attribution_title: Host, Awarepreneurs; business coach for social entrepreneurs
